_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/ledger/test_life_gained_this_turn.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_moors_witch` is Witch of the Moors' trigger shape -- your end step, if you gained life this turn -- with an effect a test can read off a life total instead of a sacrifice and a graveyard target.
